name: Bayesian Statistical Modelling and Computation
description: The course will cover the use of Bayesian statistical models for a range of standard settings including regression, causal inference, and generalised linear models; in this context it will introduce key conceptual ideas like sampling, inference, confounding, Bayesian regularisation and model comparison, and also draw contrasts with frequentist ways of thinking about these notions.
